paragraphs: Menashya bar Menaḥem. Menashya bar Menaḥem's household squeezed pomegranates. R. Naḥman said the law follows Menashya bar Menaḥem. Rava asked Rav Naḥman, 'Is Menashya bar Menaḥem a tanna?'—a rhetorical question, Shabbat 144b. In Rav's time: I do not know the basis for saying he lived in Rav's time.
